output.brief: Cancelling RotaWeave is not supported by the evidence. The drop comes from two changes acting together. On the basic tier, a regular keeps a weekly slot only if staff book it before the Thursday release. Until 30 April, staff booked about 74 slots a week at Dock Street and Westgate. After the coordinator posts ended on 1 May, that fell to 3 a week, and one admin seat has sat unused. Regulars lost their usual slots to new sign-ups. Of 213 April regulars there, 129 lost a slot at least twice, and 88% of those are now inactive. Only 11% of those who kept their slot are inactive. Millbrook has the app and a coordinator, and it is stable. Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but has no app and a paper roster kept by the lead volunteer, and it is also stable. The background check does not explain the drop: 121 of the 123 who lapsed had a current check, and 21 of the 23 deactivated were reactivated. Commonplate is a minor factor: 2 of the 61 people reached by callback joined another group. What to do: have a staff member or trained lead volunteer book regulars into their usual slots at Dock Street and Westgate, and phone lapsed regulars to offer their slot back. Do not cancel the contract, suspend the checks, or purge the roster. My confidence is fairly high. The data is observational, but the pattern across sites is consistent.
